findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: CLAUDE.md:396 and AGENTS.md:126 show `lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-xxxx --mergeMain --refreshStale --validate` (POSIX flag style) but the actual CLI accepts only JSON args: `lattice done_prepare '{"storyId":"B-xxxx","mergeMain":true,"refreshStale":true,"validate":true}'`. No --mergeMain / --refreshStale / --validate POSIX flags exist in command-catalog.ts schema or any source; a host following the runbook literally would get an unknown-flag error. Fix: replace the inline example with the JSON invocation style consistent with the rest of the codebase and with session_brief output.
